description: This Java source file defines the ServiceOrderValidator class, which extends OrderValidator and implements the Validator interface. It provides validation logic specifically for ServiceOrder objects in the OpenMRS project, ensuring the correctness of the specimen source attribute among other validations.

classes.name: ServiceOrderValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating ServiceOrder instances, specifically checking the specimen source to ensure it is among the allowed test specimen sources.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if the provided class is a ServiceOrder class or a subclass, indicating whether this validator can validate instances of that class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a ServiceOrder object, verifying that the specimen source is valid and adding appropriate errors if not.
